modmenu.summaryTranslation.moogs_paths: Adds a generated network of paths and trails to the overworld, with biome-specific surfaces and scattered decorations like cairns, signposts and shrines. Fully configurable through datapacks.
moogs_paths.config.title: Moog's Paths
moogs_paths.config.notice: How often each path network lays a path, from 0% (never) to 100% (every time). Changes apply when a world starts, to paths not laid yet. Lowering one only leaves paths out; it never moves a path. A server uses its own config/moogs_paths.json.
moogs_paths.config.unreadable: config/%s can't be read, so changes here won't be saved. Fix or delete the file.
moogs_paths.cloth_required.title: Cloth Config needed
moogs_paths.cloth_required.message: The path rarity sliders need Cloth Config. Without it, set each path's chance (0 to 100) in config/moogs_paths.json.
